thought.text: The latest release is a CVE-only one. Let me get the specific release that has the linux-amd64 binary (2025-09-07) and also fetch the `mc` client:

reasoning_content: The latest release only has CVE/security release notes. Let's get the actual release list with browser_download_url for the linux-amd64 minio server. The 2025-09-07 release had assets. Let me fetch that specific release's assets and download the minio server binary. Also grab mc (client) from the minio/mc repo.

action.command:
cd /tmp
TAG="RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z"
echo "=== downloading minio server $TAG ==="
timeout 180 curl -sSL -o minio_server "https://github.com/minio/minio/releases/download/${TAG}/minio.linux-amd64.${TAG}" -w "HTTP %{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n"
ls -la minio_server; file minio_server 2>/dev/null
echo "=== mc client latest assets ==="
curl -sSL -m 30 "https://api.github.com/repos/minio/mc/releases/latest" | grep -E '"tag_name"|"browser_download_url".*linux-amd64' | head
